# ADR NNNN: <Decision title>

- **Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR MMMM (`MMMM-title.md`)
- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Layer:** decision record, attached to the layer that needs it (usually the HLD)

ADRs are numbered once and never versioned. A changed decision is a new ADR that supersedes the old one; the old one only gets its Status line updated.
